phases.title: Foundation
items: Adopt Morning Calibration (2.3) and The Perfect Week (2.13) immediately.
Run The Boredom Tolerance Ladder (2.8) week by week; keep the daily 30-minute block.
One-Task Rule (2.6) every workday; paper next-actions for every interruption.
Sleep: guard the 7.5–8-hour window for the full 30 days before judging any other intervention. Track it; if you average under 7, nothing else gets credit.
Weekly 20-minute review; log inputs daily, outputs weekly.
phases.milestone: By day 30, a stable week skeleton exists and attention blocks are non-negotiable. Exit criteria: 25/30 days with calibration done and no zero days.

phases.title: Identity and Intensity
items: Add The Identity Stack (2.4) and The God-Mode Protocol (2.9) to the skeleton.
Add The Flow Alignment Loop (2.5) and The Discovery Protocol (2.7) for the one goal that matters most.
Run the first Belief Audit (2.1) this month; pick one belief to test.
Log every God-Mode block; adjust the 70% targets upward once.
phases.milestone: 3–4 God-Mode blocks delivered with logged outputs; identity floor met 25/30 days.

phases.title: Subtraction and Expansion
items: Run The Equation Check (2.2) on any new claim you're about to adopt; audit your environment for drains and remove one trigger per week (2.12).
Run The Vacuum Protocol (2.10) and The Lag Reframe (2.11) to convert desire into non-attached action.
Quarterly: re-run the Belief Audit, one dopamine-reset day (2.12), and the full Sunday review (2.13).
phases.milestone: Two consecutive months of floor-consistent behavior, one tested belief completed with objective data, and a written list of what you subtracted — and what it did.

rules: Start nothing new while something existing is slipping.
One protocol at a time, 70% scale, zero-day floor.
When results lag, review inputs (2.11), not the plan.
When a claim sounds too good, run the equation check (2.2) — and when it fails, keep the behavior if it works, and drop the story either way.
